messages:
oliver: Heads up — security will require all user SSH keys in our accounts to be ed25519 (no rsa) and we are enabling ephemeral cert-based SSH for prod bastions. Read the timeline and actions below.

nina: Is this for everyone or just prod?

oliver: Applies to all org accounts that access infra (dev/prod/staging). Rationale: RSA keys <4096 are weak and long-lived keys increase risk; ephemeral certs give us centralized revocation and short TTLs.

chao: Timeline? We have scheduled maintenance this week.

oliver: Rollout plan:
- 2026-06-10 00:00 UTC: New key policy enforced on account creation.
- 2026-06-24 00:00 UTC: Backfill scan runs and owners are auto-notified for non-compliant keys.
- 2026-07-01 00:00 UTC: Non-compliant keys removed from authorized_keys on bastions unless an exception is approved.

sec-bot: Automated inventory (2026-06-03 08:42 UTC): Found 134 SSH keys not using ed25519 across all orgs. Created tickets: SEC-8920..SEC-8933.

nina: How do I check keys for my team?

oliver: Run this helper: 
```
./tools/ssh-audit.sh --org your-team --output csv
# sample output columns: username,key_type,created_at,blob_hash\```
We will publish the script in the repo `infra/tools/ssh-audit`. Also: `rwdnctl auth ssh-keys list --owner your-team`

chao: How should engineers rotate keys? Any preferred tool?

oliver: Preferred flow: generate ed25519 locally, add to idp (SCIM) or to the Console -> SSH keys, then run `rwdnctl auth ssh-keys add --file ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub --owner your-team`. For ephemeral access, use `rwdnctl auth request-cert --role bastion-user --duration 2h`. Example: 
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "team@redwood.com"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | rwdnctl auth ssh-keys add --owner team-foo
rwdnctl auth request-cert --role bastion-user --duration 2h | tee cert.pem
ssh -i cert.pem ec2-user@bastion.redwood.com\```

nina: What about CI systems using deploy keys? They can't always use ephemeral certs.

oliver: CI should use machine service identities (OIDC) or deploy keys rotated via the token rotation service. If you must use SSH keys, create a scoped machine account and request an exception with compensating controls (IP allowlist, monitoring). Exceptions expire after 30 days.

infra-bot: We detected 9 repos with embedded RSA private keys in history (git secrets alert). Owners: infra/db-sync, infra/backup, ci/runners. Patches recommended.

chao: Anything automated for owners?

oliver: We'll attach a CSV to each SEC ticket listing offending keys and owners. Owners should either: rotate to ed25519 and confirm in ticket, or request a documented exception. Non-responses by 2026-07-01 result in automatic removal.

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-06-23 00:00 UTC.

nina: Can we get an office hour? Some teams have old lab machines that need help.

oliver: Office hour: 2026-06-15 17:00 UTC in #eng-security. Also attaching migration checklist in the pinned thread.

chao: Acknowledged. I'll run the audit and start rotating keys this afternoon. :thumbsup:

oliver: Thanks — paste audit outputs into the SEC ticket or attach CSV. If you hit blockers ping me or open a JIRA: SEC-ESCL-KEYMIG.
